attributes.action: Introduce measures to reduce petrol and diesel prices at UK fuel pumps
attributes.additional_details:
Motorists are facing rapidly rising fuel costs.

In Stafford, recent advertised prices have ranged from 171.7p to 199.9p per litre for E10 petrol, 181.9p to 218.9p for E5, 197.7p to 217.9p for B5 diesel, and 219.7p to 236.9p for premium diesel, including prices at motorway services.

At these prices, a 50-litre fill can cost almost £100 for E10 and around £118 for premium diesel. A 70-litre diesel fill can cost over £165.

Fuel costs affect not only private motorists but also workers, carers, families, tradespeople, delivery businesses, taxis, buses and haulage.

We believe the Government should review fuel taxation and competition and consider measures that provide motorists with meaningful relief when pump prices rise substantially.
attributes.background: We want the Government to introduce measures to reduce petrol and diesel prices, including reviewing fuel duty and VAT on road fuel, strengthening fuel-price transparency and competition, and ensuring tax or wholesale-price reductions are passed on to motorists at the pump.

rejection.details:
We understand that you're concerned about the cost of petrol and diesel prices, but we're not exactly sure what measures you want to see to bring down the cost. You could start a new petition calling for a specific measure to be introduced. We currently have these petitions open on this issue which you may wish to sign:

Stop charging VAT on fuel duty
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/782666

Reduce fuel tax to 20p per litre and VAT to 10% for petrol, diesel & heating oil
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/766440

Create a UK fuel security and price strategy
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/782904

Introduce a temporary 10p fuel duty cut when petrol prices exceed £1.65 a litre
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781690
